title: Formula encoding and clause fragment
statement: Let $\varphi=(C_1,\ldots,C_m)$ be a CNF formula over variables indexed by the natural numbers. Form a bit string by concatenating, for each clause $C_i$, a true bit followed by its clause encoding; then the encoding of $\varphi$ is exactly this string followed by one false bit.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables
